task: Carry checker-issued ReturnValue authority through source-free handler serialization and import for Phase 26 X1.
observation: X1 reached an imported on_fail handler and failed at `reply 9`: checker ReturnValue requirements existed for the source handler, but Section 2 serialization emitted facts only for function/method Returns and dropped handler Reply facts. impact: The failure was invisible to source-level checker validation and function/method artifact tests. resolution.summary: X1 passes on the repair candidate, including Section 2 import, Fast Debug and native execution; the same X1 harness fails on the integrated base at the missing imported Reply authority.
